depiction.primary_object: rectangular briefcase with top handle and center latch

readings.meaning: briefcase, work bag, or attaché case

ambiguity: Can be confused with a toolbox, first-aid kit case, or small suitcase when seen at very small sizes.
task_intents: clean out old receipts from bag

Update employment history dates on the background check form
Submit the Q3 consulting retainer proposal to the client procurement portal
Send two-weeks notice to HR once the signed offer letter and start date are confirmed
Set up a separate sole-proprietorship business account so freelance income stays off personal statements
Put the spare USB-C charger, presentation clicker, and printed handouts into the briefcase tonight
Draft answers for the behavioral round
Finish the mandatory annual compliance modules

Llevar el portafolio de cuero al zapatero para cambiar la hebilla

reasoning: A classic front-view briefcase with a top handle and central latch, universally understood both literally as a work bag/briefcase and figuratively as work, job, career, or business. It fits a wide range of employment, job-hunting, and office tasks, though at small sizes it slightly resembles a toolbox or a small suitcase.
